verdict.rationale: Morph's docs describe serving several open-weight chat models through one shared, token-billed OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, with prefix caching on 'every open source model' and batch at half price. However, the only open-weight family actually named is Kimi K3, so the breadth of the catalog is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented model catalog naming Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS or similar families; evidence of how broad and current the catalog is; independent corroboration of catalog breadth.
